title: A page opened in a space becomes its last page, which choosing the space opens
when: In a browser, opens a record and follows a link in its wiki to another, then goes to the products page and chooses the space.
then: Expects the rail's link to the space to name the page followed to, and choosing the space to open it.

title: a move changes only the active tab's place, even onto a record another tab holds
when: In a browser with the desktop bridge stubbed and two tabs, the second opened by Cmd+click on a box, follows a link in the second tab, clicks a box and steps by the arrows onto the record the first tab holds, then goes Back.
then: Expects the second tab active after every move, on the record moved to, the first tab's place unchanged, and Back stepping within the second tab.

title: the address and the window's history follow the active tab, clicked or cycled
when: In a browser with the desktop bridge stubbed and two tabs, each moved through two records, clicks the first tab, goes Back, then presses Ctrl+Tab and goes Back.
then: Expects the address to name the first tab's place after the click and Back to step through the first tab's history; after Ctrl+Tab the address names the second tab's place and Back steps through its own history.

title: An opened window gets its app server
when: Runs the real shell, hidden, on a small product folder and reads the address its window loaded and the answer to `GET /api/product/list-products` there.
then: Expects the window's address on `http://127.0.0.1` at a port of its own, never `:5199`, and `GET /api/product/list-products` there to answer 200.

title: A closed window's server stops
when: Step 6 of "A day with the desktop app": close every window, then run `ps -A | grep vite`.
then: No dev server the shell started is left.

title: An opened folder goes to the top of the recent folders
when: Runs the real shell, hidden, on a small product folder and reads recent-folders.json in its user data folder.
then: Expects `recent-folders.json` to hold exactly the opened folder.

title: A closed window's chat ends
when: Opens a session and listening in a folder's chat, then raises Product window closed for the folder.
then: The session and the listener are closed, the chat is gone, and the stop is kept until it settles.
